name: University of Maribor
summary: Founded 1975, 17 faculties and about 15,800 students; three English-taught bachelor's in business, tourism and crisis management, all fee-paying.

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as a Slovenian general matura with no recognition step, and its result stands in for school years 3–4 in the ranking. The IB certificate alone needs recognition.

apply.via: eVŠ national portal (joint call for enrolment)

programmes.name: Economic and Business Studies
programmes.about: English-taught specialisation of the Economic and Business Sciences degree: economics, international business, marketing and management, then a choice of business management, health-care management or supply chains in year two.
programmes.ib: English-taught specialisation; in 2026/27 it is listed as part-time study, so it is fee-paying for EU citizens too.
programmes.selectionNote: If applicants exceed places, ranked on converted IB points under the national rules; the exact formula is in the annual call. 2026/27 places shown.

programmes.name: Contemporary Tourism Practices
programmes.about: A professional tourism degree (180 ECTS) taught in English in Ljubljana: tourism products, entrepreneurship, marketing, languages and a 560-hour internship.
programmes.ib: English programme runs in Ljubljana as part-time study, equivalent to the Slovenian full-time one; fee-paying for EU citizens too.
programmes.selectionNote: If applicants exceed places, ranked on converted IB points under the national rules; the exact formula is in the annual call. 2026/27 places shown.

programmes.name: Crisis Management
programmes.about: A professional degree (180 ECTS) at the Faculty of Organizational Sciences in Kranj: crisis management, psychology and law in crises, information support and communication.
programmes.ib: English-language instruction is shown in the 2026/27 places table and price list, not on the programme page; ask the faculty. Part-time, fee-paying.
programmes.selectionNote: If applicants exceed places, ranked on converted IB points under the national rules; the exact formula is in the annual call. 2026/27 places shown.

notes: All three English programmes are listed as part-time study in the 2026/27 places table, so EU citizens pay tuition; full-time study is free for EU citizens only in the Slovenian-language degrees.
The places table also shows a Slovene-language Business Administration and several logistics degrees; none is marked English for 2026/27, so they are not listed.
Two of the three run away from Maribor: Contemporary Tourism Practices in Ljubljana (Student Campus) and Crisis Management in Kranj.
